# Economy audit tables (generated by scripts/economy-audit.ts)

Read-only measurements; no game number is changed. See docs/economy-audit.md for the audit text, proposals and open questions.
## A. Block classification

All 62 registered blocks. "Today" = what the code does now. Price columns are for shown blocks only (base price, copy growth x1.18 per copy owned, L1->L2 upgrade = base x 2.0). `Up?` = the proposed upgrade flag after the owner's rule; `?` = ambiguous, the recommendation is in brackets. Level text is the in-game description at L1 and at the top level.

## B. Marginal value of the 1st..6th copy

Circuit: one lane on the Fan (generator, then Flat+, then k copies of the block in a straight line, ejector; Flat+ itself has no Flat+ in front). Fan fires 4 pulses/s. Targets are sized to the circuit's own estimate (scripts/lib/dmgBench.ts), so the number is HP removed per second on the real engine, not a formula. Each cell = DPS with k copies / DPS with k-1 copies (copy 1 is against the bare Flat+ circuit). `cap` = the last copy whose best-scenario gain is at least 5% (cap 1: nothing from the 2nd copy). Upgradable blocks are tested at L1 and at their top level; a block without upgrades runs at its fixed level.

### B2. Routing blocks: lanes reaching an ejector

Splitters and routers add LANES (one projectile per lane per pulse), and a lane only counts if it ends in an ejector, so the useful copies are limited by the hull's ejectors (Dart 1, Twin 1, Prong 2, Fan 3, Shuttle 1). Compiled circuits below (Flat+ in front, turns placed by hand); "lanes" = recipes the compiler finds, est DPS from the compiler, engine mixed = mean of the three engine scenarios.

| circuit | lanes | est DPS | engine mixed HP/s | engine x vs one lane |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Prong: Turn R + Turn L (one lane) | 1 | 4.0 | 3.3 |  |
| Prong: Splitter 2 + Turn L | 1 | 4.0 | 3.3 |  |
| Prong: Splitter 3 + Turn L | 2 | 8.0 | 6.7 |  |
| Fan: Flat+ only (one lane) | 1 | 8.0 | 6.6 | x1.00 |
| Fan: Splitter 2 (+2 turns) | 2 | 16.0 | 13.6 | x2.06 |
| Fan: Splitter 2 + 2nd Splitter 2 (hand-routed) | 3 | 24.0 | 20.2 | x3.06 |
| Fan: Splitter 3 (+2 turns) | 3 | 24.0 | 20.2 | x3.06 |
| Fan: Splitter 3 + 2nd Splitter 3 on the middle lane | 3 | 24.0 | 20.2 | x3.06 |
| Fan: Alternator (+2 turns) | 2 | 17.6 | 14.7 | x2.24 |
| Fan: Random Router L1 (+2 turns) | 2 | 13.6 | 11.0 | x1.68 |

Turns cost no DPS; the number you need is set by the routing (see the turn counts of the long lines in C3).

## C. Damage ceilings

### C1. Percent x per-copy ladder (assumed)

Owner: x1.5 at L1 to x3 at the top level, ownership cap 10. Assumed ladder: **linear in log space** (the per-copy factor is multiplied by 1.08 each level, i.e. 1.5 x 2^((L-1)/9)), top level = L10 (today's maxLevel). Today's code: x(1+0.5 L), i.e. x1.5 at L1 and x6 at L10.

| level | per copy (proposed) | 10 copies all at this level | per copy (today) | 10 copies (today) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| L1 | x1.50 | x57.67 | x1.50 | x57.67 |
| L2 | x1.62 | x125 | x2.00 | x1024 |
| L3 | x1.75 | x269 | x2.50 | x9537 |
| L4 | x1.89 | x581 | x3.00 | x59049 |
| L5 | x2.04 | x1256 | x3.50 | x275855 |
| L6 | x2.20 | x2712 | x4.00 | x1.05e+6 |
| L7 | x2.38 | x5858 | x4.50 | x3.41e+6 |
| L8 | x2.57 | x12655 | x5.00 | x9.77e+6 |
| L9 | x2.78 | x27336 | x5.50 | x2.53e+7 |
| L10 | x3.00 | x59049 | x6.00 | x6.05e+7 |

With 10 copies: all L1 = **x57.67**, all L5 (mid) = **x1256**, all L10 = **x59049**. (Today's L10 ladder: x6.05e+7.) Per-level step at 10 copies: x2.16, so an upgrade of the block (all copies at once) is worth about x2 per level once 10 copies are owned.

### C2. Chance boosters: proposed values and caps, and the stacked ceiling

Average multiplier per copy (expected value; the engine rolls each shot). They multiply with Percent x. Lucky Strike and Jackpot keep today's numbers (already weaker than Percent x per copy: x1.33..1.43 and x1.36..1.54 against x1.5..x3). Gambler's Gate today is x1.5..x1.8 (as strong as Percent x at L1 and it also loses half the shots), so a weaker chance is proposed.

| block | avg x per copy L1 | avg x per copy L3 | proposed cap | all copies L1 | all copies L3 | note |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Lucky Strike | x1.33 | x1.43 | 6 | x5.53 | x8.55 | engine as today: 33%->43% x2 |
| Jackpot | x1.36 | x1.54 | 6 | x6.33 | x13.34 | engine as today: 4%->6% x10 |
| Gambler’s Gate | x1.20 | x1.50 | 4 | x2.07 | x5.06 | PROPOSED chance 40%->50% (today 50%->60% = avg x1.5..x1.8, as strong as Percent x at L1-L3) |
| all three at their caps | | | 16 copies | x72.62 | x577 | |

### C3. Hull limits: how many multipliers physically fit in one line

A multiplier needs a straight cell on the signal's path (a turn block takes its own cell). Lines may cross but not overlap, so the longest self-avoiding path from the generator to an ejector is searched (randomised depth-first search, 2e6 (Shuttle 6e6) nodes x 12 restarts, plus a hand-built snake for the Fan; a LOWER bound for the two big hulls) and then **built with Percent x on the straight cells and Turn blocks on the turn cells and compiled**, to prove the compiler accepts it and counts that many multipliers.

| hull | buildable cells | ejectors | pulses/s | straight cells in the longest line found | turns (L/R) | compiled multipliers | compiled recipes | lanes after the multipliers |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| dart | 1 | 1 | 2 | 1 | 0 / 0 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| twin | 2 | 1 | 2.5 | 2 | 0 / 0 | 2 | 1 | 1 |
| prong | 3 | 2 | 4 | 1 | 0 / 0 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| fan | 72 | 3 | 4 | 51 | 8 / 8 | 51 | 1 | 3 |
| shuttle | 47 | 1 | 5 | 31 | 4 / 4 | 31 | 1 | 1 |

Lanes after the multipliers: a Splitter 3 placed LAST in the line (after the multipliers) shares their damage between the lanes; Fan has 3 ejectors, Prong 2 but its only free cells are the splitter cell and one straight cell, so there the choice is one multiplier on one lane or a Splitter 3 and none before it (counted as 1 lane here). Shuttle has one ejector.

### C4. Ceiling per hull: cap-based next to the real (slot-limited) one

Damage per shot = base x Percent x chain x chance chain. Base damage 2 = generator 1 + one Flat+ L1 (the starter build, hero level 0). DPS = shot x lanes x pulses/s. Percent x copies used: cap-based = 10 on every hull; real = min(10, straight cells in the longest line). Chance boosters: proposed caps in C2, real = what is left of the line after the Percent x slots (they also need straight cells), taken at all-L3 values.

| hull | Percent x slots (real) | shot, 10 copies all L1 | real shot all L1 | real shot all L10 | cap-based shot all L10 | cap-based shot all L10 + all chance blocks (L3) | real DPS all L10 + chance blocks that fit | cap-based DPS (same) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| dart | 1 | 115 | 3.00 | 6.00 | 118098 | 6.82e+7 | 12.00 | 1.36e+8 |
| twin | 2 | 115 | 4.50 | 18.00 | 118098 | 6.82e+7 | 45.00 | 1.70e+8 |
| prong | 1 | 115 | 3.00 | 6.00 | 118098 | 6.82e+7 | 24.00 | 2.73e+8 |
| fan | 10 | 115 | 115 | 118098 | 118098 | 6.82e+7 | 8.18e+8 | 8.18e+8 |
| shuttle | 10 | 115 | 115 | 118098 | 118098 | 6.82e+7 | 3.41e+8 | 3.41e+8 |

Flat+ is additive and goes first: each copy at L10 adds +10 to the base, so 10 Flat+ L10 and hero level 10 make the base 1 + 5 + 100 = 106 (x53 on the starter's 2) and multiply every number above by 53.

Wall: effective HP of the toughest block (shield + HP x armor factor, `blockCost`), median block, whole-wall HP and the DPS needed to clear it before it reaches a ship at the bottom (the balance-damage "clear DPS"). Tier HP stops growing at tier 38 (rows, armor and shields grow).

### D3. Three candidate price families

Copy price = base x growth^owned, per block; bases by block band: cheap (turns, Splitter 2), normal (Percent x, Flat+, chance boosters scaled), expensive (Splitter 3, AoE, Homing, Chain Lightning, Fork, Residue Seed, Overkill Spill: 1 copy). Upgrade ladder = normal base x 2 x u^(L-1), L1->L10. Percent x sets the yardstick; "full cheap set" = 4 Turn L + 4 Turn R + 2 Splitter 2 (cheap base all, growth per block type). ## E. Hero level cost

### E1. Medal supply

Campaign: 1 Medal per tier's first full clear (tiers 1-100: 100 Medals, only if every wall is CLEARED, passing pays none). Free Fly milestones (waves 5/10/15/20/30/40/50): 1+2+2+3+4+5+6 = **23** Medals once per save. Frontier: a Medal marker on a seeded share of squares (chance 8% at the origin falling to 2% far out, x2.5 in dead-end pockets), paid on the first CLEAR of that square (the Free Fly squares count as squares too). Counts below are exact for the shipped seed 15015:

| Frontier through ring | open squares | squares with a Medal | Medals if every one is cleared | Medals per 100 open squares |

| 10 | 366 | 20 | 20 | 5.5 |
| 25 | 2155 | 79 | 79 | 3.7 |
| 50 | 8566 | 209 | 209 | 2.4 |
| 100 | 33855 | 613 | 613 | 1.8 |

(Free Fly column: milestones reached by that point, an assumption: waves 5 / 10 / 15 / 20 / 30 / 40 / 50 = 1 / 3 / 5 / 8 / 12 / 17 / 23 cumulative.)

Other Medal sinks: captains 0 + 10 + 25 + 50 = 85; options 2/4/7/11 per option, one option per tier for each of the 4 captains = 96 (both options of every tier = 192). So the hero shares the supply with up to 181 Medals of captain spending.

## F. Numeric safety (computed facts)

Projectile damage is stored in a Float32Array (`src/engine/pools.ts`): it overflows to Infinity above 3.40e+38 and keeps 24 bits of precision (7 digits). Facts for a clamp of 1e+12:

| wave | tier | basic Rock parent HP | Mother HP | HP above 1e12? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 40 | 105 | 7.88e+6 | 2.37e+7 | no |
| 50 | 131 | 2.95e+8 | 8.86e+8 | no |
| 60 | 158 | 1.17e+10 | 3.50e+10 | no |
| 70 | 185 | 4.62e+11 | 1.38e+12 | yes (Mother) |
| 75 | 198 | 2.83e+12 | 8.48e+12 | yes (Mother) |
| 80 | 211 | 1.73e+13 | 5.19e+13 | yes (Mother) |
| 100 | 265 | 2.70e+16 | 8.11e+16 | yes (Mother) |

First wave whose Mother HP exceeds 1e12: **wave 70**. First wave whose basic Rock exceeds it: 73. Wall HP at the cap (tier 38+) stays in the hundreds. Credits / reward growth 1.05^tier is far below 1e12 within any reachable tier.

NaN path: `Infinity x 0` and `Infinity - Infinity` are NaN, and `if (d <= 0 ...) return 0` in the Gun is false for NaN, so a NaN packet would fire. Demonstration: Infinity*0 = NaN, (NaN <= 0) = false.
